lines.speaker: Nadine Khoury
lines.text: I have presented to the audit committee every quarter since 2021.

profile.title: General Manager, Saudi Arabia
profile.summary: Runs the Saudi business of a diagnostics distributor.

notes.body: Her commercial team of 38 has lost two people in three years; she hired 21 of them herself.

lines.speaker: Yara Haddad
lines.text: Tell me about a tender you won.

lines.speaker: Huda Al-Rashed
lines.text: The 2024 national laboratory tender. I registered eleven products with the regulator in the year before it, so we could bid on every lot, and we won seven of nine.

lines.speaker: Huda Al-Rashed
lines.text: I walked away from one hospital deal because the buyer wanted a payment to a consultant I could not explain to my auditors.

documents.title: Reference from the regional president
documents.text: Huda has owned the Saudi P&L since 2020. Revenue grew from USD 96m to USD 148m and she has met plan in four of five years.
